messages:
lina_sales: Quick sync — BrightBank POC hit blockers during on-prem trial in APAC. They pinned model `redwood/gpt-4o-2024-11` and calls are returning `model_not_available_in_region` errors. Also seeing 429s on burst tests. Customer asking: can we (a) guarantee model parity for Private installs, (b) temporary workaround, and (c) pricing delta if they need Dedicated seat instead?

alex_infra: Can you paste the exact error and a sample request? region + model_id pls.

lina_sales: Error log snippet from their side: ```
HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
{
  "error": {
    "code": "model_not_available_in_region",
    "message": "Model 'redwood/gpt-4o-2024-11' not available in apac-east private pool"
  }
}
```
Request shows: `region: apac-east`, `model: redwood/gpt-4o-2024-11`, `pin_version: 2024-11-02`.

priya_se: Two things: 1) APAC private packages sometimes lag curated model onboarding — we onboard on-demand but need model build + perf verification for on-prem. 2) 429s are likely from their load test hitting the local gateway concurrency limits, not model availability. Need more logs.

marco_eng: Confirming — the model bundle for that exact pinned version wasn't pushed to the apac installer that they ran. We had a deprecation note for 2024-11-02 variant in the internal tracker (we suggested migrating to `gpt-4o-2025-01` family). If they must stick to that pin, we can trigger an on-prem build but that's an ops SOW (lead time ~2-3 biz days for build + QA).

sara_cs: Customer is pushing for fast workaround — they don't want SOW delays. Any short-term options?

alex_infra: Short-term workaround options (ranked):
1) Use a compatible model alias that is already in the APAC bundle: e.g., `redwood/gpt-4o-compat-v1` (behavior close, not identical). Update client to request `model_alias: gpt-4o-compat-v1` or `model: redwood/gpt-4o-compat-v1`.
2) Switch to hosted endpoint in us-west while we set up a secure tunnel (VPN) for private traffic — incurs egress/security review but fastest to unblock.
3) If they have Dedicated trial capacity in APAC, switch routing to a dedicated pool where the model is deployed. That requires sales/legal approval for dedicated trial and different pricing.

priya_se: For the 429s during load test, ask them to share gateway logs showing `concurrency_limit_exceeded` or token-per-second spikes. Common quick mitigation: lower client concurrency and enable streaming so connections are less bursty. Also check their request batching config.

lina_sales: They pasted a short gateway log: ```
[2026-09-21T14:02:33Z] ERROR request id=bdc123 status=429 reason=rate_limited concurrency=64 limit=50 model=redwood/gpt-4o-2024-11
[2026-09-21T14:02:34Z] INFO fallback_used=false
```
They claim concurrency=64 from their load generator.

marco_eng: That's expected — gateway is dropping above 50. We can provide a suggested client config (no code change on server): reduce parallel streams to 40 and add exponential backoff with jitter. Also enable `prefer_streaming: true` to keep sockets open.

lina_sales: Security question from their infosec: can Private deployment use their KMS (HSM) for model keys and does key rotation work transparently?

priya_se: Yes, Private supports customer-managed KMS/HSM integrations. For on-prem we rely on the install's key provider; for VPC we integrate with customer KMS via IAM roles. Need to collect their KMS vendor and rotation policy; send standard SSO/KMS checklist.

sara_cs: They also asked about pricing: if we recommend Dedicated for parity, what's the delta vs hosted trial?

marco_eng: Pricing call — Dedicated is committed monthly pricing (guaranteed capacity) + infra markup. For a short trial we can propose a 30-day dedicated eval with a reduced commitment and a one-time setup fee; ask sales to draft. Lina, do you want me to include an estimate for model build SOW too?

lina_sales: Yes please — include estimated SOW cost/time for pushing the pinned model to their bundle. Also note security review delay if we use hosted bridge.

deploy-bot: [notice] apac-onprem-bundle build status: queued -> requires manual approval by eng-runtime (ticket ENG-9682).

alex_infra: I'll open ENG-9682 and link the customer's POC id. Action items: (1) lena@eng-runtime to approve build (2) sara_cs to confirm whether they accept model alias behavioral delta (3) lina to collect gateway logs + exact concurrency profile (4) sales to prepare dedicated-trial one-pager and SOW estimate.

priya_se: Quick config snippet for their client (suggested):
```json
{
  "model": "redwood/gpt-4o-compat-v1",
  "region": "apac-east",
  "max_concurrency": 40,
  "retry": { "max_attempts": 5, "base_backoff_ms": 200, "jitter": true },
  "prefer_streaming": true
}
```
Note: send as fenced code block in their SDK language; they use Node.

lina_sales: I'll send this to BrightBank and ask if they prefer alias or bridged hosted while we triage. Also asking infosec to confirm KMS vendor. Will update thread when I have their choice.

sara_cs: If they take alias path, prod migration note: we should schedule a model-evals run to validate prompts for drift; can we add an automatic quality check before we finalize?

marco_eng: Yes — add a quick eval harness run (1k prompts) as part of the on-prem build acceptance. Put estimate in SOW.

lina_sales: TL;DR (for execs): BrightBank POC blocked by pinned model missing in their APAC on-prem bundle and gateway 429s from high concurrency. Short-term: use compat alias or bridge to hosted with secure tunnel. Long-term: on-prem model build (SOW) or Dedicated trial. Sales to provide cost delta and SOW estimate. Opening support ticket INC-2591 for follow-up.

sara_cs: :thumbsup:

alex_infra: I'll start ENG ticket and cc eng-runtime. Keep me posted.

lina_sales: thanks everyone — updating customer now.
